hero.description.line1: Okukola emikutu, apu n'okukola ebintu otomatiki
hero.description.line2: mu bwangu, ku bbeeyi entono era ng'osanyuse.
hero.board.title: Olubaawo lw'okutandika
services.description: Tugatta enkola y'ebiri ku mukutu, endabika n'tekinologiya ow'ekikugu omukutu gwo guleme kubeera ku yintaneeti bubeezi, wabula gukole bulungi.
services.0.title: Portfolio / CV ey'obuntu
services.0.description: Omukutu gwa portfolio oba CV yo okulaga ebikukwatako, obumanyirivu n'emirimu gyo mu ngeri ey'ekikugu.
services.1.title: Landing page oba ebikwata ku kkampuni
services.1.description: Landing page oba ebikwata ku kkampuni ebitandika mangu, ebirabika obulungi era ebiyamba okusikiriza abaguzi.
services.1.item.1: Dizayini ekwatagana n'ebyuma byonna era ekola
services.2.title: Enkola y'amawulire n'emirimu
services.2.description: Dashboard, portal n'enkola ez'omunda okuddukanya data yo n'emirimu gya bizineesi egya buli lunaku.
services.3.title: Okukola otomatiki
services.3.description: Kola otomatiki emirimu egy'okuddiŋŋana nga obubaka, okuyunga ebikozesebwa n'enkola z'emirimu, ekibiina kyo kiwonye obudde.
process.description: Buli mutendera guliko ebivaamu by'osobola okulaba, okugezesa n'okukkiriza. Omanya bulungi omulimu gye guli.
process.0.title: Okwekenneenya by'weetaaga
process.0.description: Tupanga ebigendererwa bya bizineesi, endabika z'oyagala, ebikulu ebirina okubaamu n'emirimu egisooka.
process.1.title: Okwekenneenya dizayini
process.1.description: Enteekateeka, dizayini n'entambula bikeberebwa ne bikkirizibwa wamu nga tebinnatandika kukolebwa.
process.2.title: Okukola
process.2.description: Omukutu, apu oba enkola ey'otomatiki ekolebwa okukwatagana n'ebyuma byonna ng'egoberera dizayini ekkirizibwa.
process.3.title: Okwekenneenya ebivuddemu
process.3.description: Ebivuddemu tubikeberera wamu, ne tubikyusa bwe kyetaagisa, ne tubigezesa okutuusa nga biwedde okufulumizibwa.
process.4.title: Okufulumya n'okukukwasa
process.4.description: Ekintu kifulumizibwa, metadata ne SEO biteekebwawo, oluvannyuma tukukwasa okuyingira n'ebiragiro.
services.0.long: Omukutu gwa portfolio oba CV ye maka go ag'obwannannyini ku yintaneeti. Ebikukwatako, obumanyirivu n'emirimu gyo biteekebwa bulungi ku lupapula lumu, nga kyangu okubigabana n'abakozesa, abaguzi oba amatendekero.
services.0.for: Abaakamala okusoma, abakozi abeetongodde, abakola ebintu n'abakugu abaagala okulabika obulungi.
services.1.long: Landing page oba ebikwata ku kkampuni biyamba bizineesi okulabika obulungi omulundi ogusooka. Tuteekateeka entambula y'olupapula, ebigambo n'endabika abagenyi bategeere mangu by'owa era baagale okukukubira.
services.1.detail.0: Ebigambo ku lupapula ebitegeerekeka era ebikkirizisa
services.1.detail.1: Dizayini ekwatagana n'ebyuma byonna era ekola
services.1.for: Bizineesi, amasomero, kafe, ebibiina n'amakampuni ebyagala endabika ey'ekikugu.
services.2.long: Enkola y'amawulire etegeka emirimu egiriwo kati nga gisaasaanidde mu spreadsheet, ebiwandiiko n'obubaka. Data eba mu kifo kimu, esobola okuyingirwamu okusinziira ku mulimu, era lipoota osobola okuzirabako buli kiseera.
services.2.detail.0: Enkola y'emirimu entegeke egoberera engeri gy'okolamu
services.2.detail.4: Ekitundu kya admin okuddukanya ebiri ku mukutu wekka
services.2.for: Amasomero, ebitongole, amaduuka, ennimiro n'amakampuni ebyagala okuddukanya data mu ngeri ennungi.
services.3.long: Emirimu egy'okuddiŋŋana nga okusindika obubaka, okuteeka data okuva mu apu emu okugenda mu ndala oba okukola lipoota ez'enjawulo gisobola okukolebwa gyokka. Ekibiina kyo kiwonya obudde era tekikola nsobi za kuwandiika.
services.3.detail.1: Obubaka obw'otomatiki ku WhatsApp oba email
services.3.detail.3: Okuyingiza data mu ngalo kukendeera nnyo
services.3.for: Bizineesi n'ebibiina ebirina emirimu mingi egy'okuddiŋŋana egikolebwa mu ngalo.
process.0.long: Nga tetunnaba kukola kintu kyonna, twagala okutegeera bizineesi yo: ekigendererwa kye ki, abagenyi be baani, n'ebintu ebisinga obukulu. Awo tusooka ku bisinga obukulu omulimu gusigale nga gunywevu era tuleme kusaasaanya ssente nnyingi.
process.0.do.2: Okulonda ebikulu ebirina okubaamu n'ensengeka y'omulimu
process.0.you: Tubuulire by'weetaaga era otulage emikutu gy'oyagala.
process.0.result: Olukalala lw'ebyetaagisa n'ebisinga obukulu bye tukkiriziganyizzaako.
process.1.long: Tusooka kuteekateeka entambula y'empapula n'ekifaananyi ky'endabika. Osobola okukyekenneenya n'otuwa endowooza nga tetunnatandika kukola, bwe kityo ekivaamu kisigala nga kifaanana by'olowooza.
process.1.do.1: Okukola dizayini y'endabika: langi, ensengeka n'engeri
process.1.do.3: Okukyusa dizayini nga tugoberera endowooza yo
process.1.you: Kebera dizayini, oluvannyuma otuwe endowooza oba okugikkiriza.
process.2.long: Dizayini bwe ekkirizibwa, omukutu, apu oba enkola ey'otomatiki ekolebwa. Ekola bulungi ku ssimu ne kompyuta, era osobola okugabana endowooza omulimu nga bwe gugenda mu maaso.
process.2.do.0: Okukola empapula n'ebikozesebwa nga tugoberera dizayini
process.2.do.1: Okukakasa nti birabika bulungi ku ssimu, tabuleeti ne kompyuta
process.2.do.2: Okuteekawo ebisookerwako osobole okulabika ku Google
process.2.you: Teekateeka ebigambo, ebifaananyi n'ebibonero, era ogabane endowooza bw'ozirina.
process.2.result: Verisoni esooka gy'osobola okugezesa. Omukutu omwangu gutera okumala ennaku 1–3 ez'okukola ng'ebyetaagisa biwedde.
process.3.long: Tugezesa ebivuddemu wamu. Ekitaba kituufu kikyusibwa, olwo byonna ne bigezesebwa nate okutuusa lwe bikola bulungi ku byuma eby'enjawulo era nga biwedde okufulumizibwa.
process.3.do.0: Okukebera endabika ku bunene bwa sikulini obw'enjawulo
process.4.long: Ekintu kifulumizibwa era kiggulwawo eri buli muntu. Tukiteekateeka okwangu okulabika ku Google, oluvannyuma tukukwasa okuyingira awamu n'ekitabo ky'okukozesa osobole okukiddukanya obulungi.
process.4.do.3: Okukuwagira n'okuddaabiriza okw'omwaka 1 ku bwereere, wamu ne domain (ppaakeeji Entono) oba hosting (ppaakeeji Ennene)
process.4.you: Kuuma bulungi by'oyingiramu otandike okubigabana n'abaguzi bo.
process.4.result: Omukutu oba apu eri ku yintaneeti era nga yeetegefu okukozesebwa.
testimonials.description: Okuva butereevu eri abaguzi be twakolera emikutu.
projects.description: Buli pulojekiti ekoleddwa okuwa obubaka bwa bizineesi mu ngeri entegeerekeka, okukola ku kyuma kyonna, n'okwanguyiza abakozesa okukola kye baagala.
packages.description: Bbeeyi esobola okukyusibwa oluvannyuma lw'okwebuuzaako, embalirira, obudde n'ebivaamu bisigale nga bituufu.
packages.0.name: Entono
packages.1.name: Ennene
packages.0.description: Omukutu gwa portfolio, CV oba landing page ennyangu etandika mangu.
packages.1.description: Ebikwata ku kkampuni, enkola y'amawulire n'emirimu, oba okukola otomatiki ebikoleddwa okusinziira ku by'weetaaga.
faq.title: Ebibuuzo ebibuuzibwa ennyo nga tebannatandika.
faq.description: Ekibuuzo kyo bwe kiba tekinnaddibwamu wano, okwebuuzaako kuyinza okuyamba okuzuula by'weetaaga.
faq.0.question: Nocoding esobola okukola buweereza ki?
faq.0.answer: Tukola emikutu gya portfolio oba CV, landing page oba ebikwata ku kkampuni, enkola z'amawulire n'emirimu, n'okukola emirimu gya bizineesi otomatiki.
faq.1.question: Okukola kutwala bbanga ki?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV oba landing page ennyangu etera okutwala ennaku 1-3 ez'okukola ng'ebyetaagisa biwedde. Pulojekiti ennene zisinziira ku bikozesebwa, okuyunga n'embiro z'endowooza.
faq.2.question: Dizayini n'ebikozesebwa bisobola okukyusibwa?
faq.2.answer: Weewaawo. Dizayini, entegeka y'empapula, ebikozesebwa n'enkola y'emirimu bisobola okukyusibwa okusinziira ku by'weetaaga. Dizayini ekeberebwa wamu nga tetunnatandika kukola.
faq.3.question: Bbeeyi erimu ki?
faq.3.answer: Bbeeyi erimu okukola okusinziira ku ppaakeeji n'ekigera kye tukkiriziganyizzaako. Ppaakeeji Entono erimu okuddaabiriza ne domain ku bwereere omwaka 1, ate ppaakeeji Ennene erimu okuddaabiriza ne hosting ku bwereere omwaka 1.
contact.title: Tubuulire omukutu gwo by'gwetaaga. Tujja kukuyamba okuzuula ekkubo.
contact.description: Tuweereze ekirowoozo ekimpi ku bizineesi yo, empapula z'oyagala n'obudde bw'oyagala. Eky'okuddamu ekisooka kijja kubaamu amagezi ku kigera n'ebiddirira. Okwebuuzaako kuba kwa bwereere buli kiseera, buli lw'okwetaaga.
footer.tagline: Emikutu gya bizineesi egyetegefu okufulumizibwa, egirabika obulungi era egyangu okukuza.
project.description.ecoswap: Akatale ka yintaneeti ak'okugula n'okutunda ebintu ebikozeseddwa. Abantu basobola okuteekayo, okunoonya n'okugula mangu nga bakozesa essimu oba kompyuta.
project.description.wiboost: Edduuka ku yintaneeti ery'obuweereza obwa digito nga top-up z'emizannyo, ppaakeeji za data n'apu eza premium, nga mulimu ssente z'abaguzi ne pulogulaamu y'abatunda.
project.description.ahawi: Omukutu gwa portfolio ogw'obuntu mu mulembe gw'okusiiga langi z'amazzi nga guliko ennimi bbiri, okwolesa ebikukwatako, obumanyirivu n'engeri y'okukukwatako.
project.description.abdi: Enkola y'ebiwandiiko by'abaweereza b'embuga (abdi dalem) aba Keraton ya Surakarta: okwewandiisa, ebikwata ku muntu, enteekateeka z'emirimu, okubeerawo n'okukuba kaadi za ID.
project.description.sfarm: Apu y'okuddukanya ennimiro y'enkoko ez'amagi n'embuzi ey'ekyalo: ebiwandiiko bya buli lunaku, okutunda, ensaasaanya ne lipoota z'ensimbi.
project.description.payu: Pulatifomu ekwataganya abateeka emirimu n'abakozi abeetongodde. Omuteesi awaayo empeera, omukozi amaliriza omulimu, era okusasula kukolebwa mu QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Olukalala lw'ebintu ku yintaneeti nga luliko ebintu ebisoba mu lukumi. Abaguzi basobola okunoonya, okulonda n'okulagira butereevu ku WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Edduuka lya apu eza premium ku yintaneeti
project.description.ianprem: Edduuka ku yintaneeti ery'akawunti z'apu eza premium nga Netflix ne Spotify. Abaguzi balonda ne basasula bokka, ate abakulembeze ba admin baddukanya stock n'okutunda.
project.description.alengka: Olukalala lwa fenicha ku yintaneeti ey'omunda n'ey'ebweru eya kafe, resitoranti n'amaka. Abagenyi basobola okulaba ebiriwo n'okwebuuza ku WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Omukutu omutongole ogw'essomero lya pulayimale nga guliko ebikwata ku ssomero, amawulire g'okuyingiza abayizi abaggya, olukalala lw'abasomesa, emirimu egy'ebweru w'ekibiina n'ebituukiddwaako by'abayizi.
project.description.furnix: Olukalala lwa fenicha ey'ekyuma okuva e Jepara ku yintaneeti eya kafe, resitoranti n'amaka. Abagenyi basobola okulonda ebintu n'okulagira nga bwe baagala.
project.description.clothique: Edduuka ly'engoye ku yintaneeti erituukiridde: olukalala, ekibbo ky'okugula, okusasula ku yintaneeti, blog n'ekitundu kya admin okuddukanya ebiragiro ne lipoota.
project.category.agli: Apu ey'okuyamba mu kukola ebiri ku mikutu
project.description.agli: Ekikozesebwa eky'ebibiina ebikola ebiri ku mikutu okukung'aanya ebyokulabirako ebisinga okulabibwa, okuzuula ebigobererwa, n'okuwandiika ebiwandiiko ebipya.
project.description.nebulist: Omuyambi w'okutunda akozesa AI akola enkola, ebiwandiiko ku bayinza okuba abaguzi n'ebiwandiiko by'obubaka okuva mu mawulire g'ekintu.
project.description.carbonfi: Apu y'ensimbi eya digito ey'okusuubula carbon credits (empeera z'okukendeeza ku bucaafu) ne pulogulaamu z'empeera ezikuuma obutonde.
project.description.protectedpay: Apu ey'obukuumi ey'okusindika ssente eza digito: ssente zifulumizibwa zokka bwe zituuka, nga mulimu okusasula mu kibinja n'okutereka.
project.description.pedulichain: Pulatifomu ey'okuwaayo etaliiko kyekusifu: buli kiweebwayo n'engeri ssente gye zikozesebwamu bitereka lubeerera era buli muntu asobola okubiraba.
project.description.astra: Omuyambi wa AI gw'oyogera naye butereevu okuddukanya ebintu bya digito, ng'okusindika tokens oba okukola ebintu ebya digito eby'okukung'aanya, nga tosaanidde kumanya kukola kodi.
project.description.auditfi: Ekikebera obukuumi ekikozesa AI eky'enkola z'ensimbi eza digito ekizuula obunafu ne kiwandiika lipoota mu sekondi.
project.description.p2p: Pulatifomu y'okuwaanyisiganya ebintu bya digito butereevu wakati w'abakozesa, nga erimu obukuumi bw'ebyobusuubuzi n'ekitundu kya admin okuddukanya pulatifomu.
project.description.payguppy: Apu eyamba amaduuka aga bulijjo okukkiriza okusasula mu ssente eza digito nga bakozesa QR codes ze balina dda.
project.description.tiptap: Pulatifomu esobozesa abakola ebiri ku mikutu okufuna tips okuva eri abalaba mu ssente eza digito oba ebintu ebya digito eby'okukung'aanya, nga waliwo okulabula mu kiseera ky'okulaga obulamu.
project.description.senkus: Omuzannyo ogw'oku yintaneeti ogw'ssaayansi n'okukola eddagala: abazannyi bagatta eddagala, bakung'aanya ebintu ebya digito, ne bavuganya mu kisaawe.
project.description.quickstock: Apu ya kompyuta ey'okuddukanya stock y'edduuka ly'engoye: okuwandiika okutunda, okuleetebwa kw'abatuusa, ne lipoota za stock, nga okuyingira kusinziira ku mulimu gwa buli mukozi.
project.description.caer: Pulatifomu y'okuwola n'okuwolebwa ebintu bya digito okuyita mu nsengekero ez'enjawulo ng'ewagira ssente eza digito eza rupiah IDRX, nga kyangu okutereka n'okuwola.

project.category.ineedsave: Omukutu gw'okuggyako ebiri ku mikutu emigatta abantu
project.description.ineedsave: Omukutu ogwa bwereere ogw'okuggyako vidiyo, ebifaananyi n'eddoboozi okuva ku TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X n'emikutu emirala. Teeka link, londa omutindo, olwo okuume.
project.category.ineedbarcode: Omukutu ogukola barcode ne QR code
project.description.ineedbarcode: Ekikozesebwa ekya bwereere ekikola barcode ne QR code nga kirina ebika bya barcode 100+. Abakozesa bateeka data, bakyusa dizayini, ne baggyako PNG eyeetegefu okukubibwa.
